sections.content: Hungarian has no separate verb for 'to have.' Instead, say Van plus a noun carrying a possessive suffix. Van egy testvérem literally means 'There is my sibling,' but it translates as 'I have a sibling.'
sections.title: Expressing 'to have'

sections.content: Negate this construction with nincs, the same word you already use for 'there isn't': Nincs testvérem — 'I don't have a sibling.'
